arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to determine the root cause of the failures and implement necessary fixes to clear the backlog. Ensure to update the cron jobs to use UTC time and check the connection pool settings in pgbouncer to prevent future issues.
arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to pgbouncer connection pool refresh. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week, with 1204 failed jobs recorded as of 12 minutes ago. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem and will now query the primary database for current failed-job counts.
